$comment: 语法大厅 G24（V0.9 P2a 骨架层）。比喻锚点：返场时确认一句「对吧？」。尾巴三规矩：同一位助手（be/do/情态）、方向相反（前肯后否）、主语缩成代词。回答跟事实走（中文「是啊/不是」陷阱重点讲）。八课亲戚 L2（助动词家族），L2 零改动。暗线侧写：isn't it 被磨成 innit。全部内容原创。
title: 反义疑问句
ketNote: KET 听力口语里高频出现；「Yes/No 跟事实走」的回答规则是听力理解的隐形考点。八课里的亲戚是 L2 的助动词家族。

sections.essence: 返场确认一句「对吧？」：尾巴用同一位助手、方向相反、主语缩成代词。
sections.why: 中文的「对吧」万能：他会游泳，对吧？你没去，对吧？——一个「对吧」走天下。英语的这声确认却要现做：It's a fine day, isn't it? / You can swim, can't you? / She likes music, doesn't she?——尾巴必须跟主句「同款」：主句用 be，尾巴就用 be；主句是实义动词，尾巴就请 do/does/did；主句有情态词，尾巴就用同一个情态词。而且方向永远相反：前面肯定、尾巴否定，前面否定、尾巴肯定——所以叫「反义」疑问句。中国孩子有两个大坑：一是拿 isn't it 当万能「对吧」到处贴——She sings well, isn't it? 是最典型的中式尾巴；二是回答：英语的 Yes/No 永远跟事实走，不跟「你说得对不对」走——You didn't go, did you? 没去就答 No, I didn't（中文却说「是啊，没去」）——这一反差是听力和口语里的隐形失分点。
sections.metaphorStory: 音乐会正式曲目演完，掌声不停，乐队返场。加演一曲后，指挥转过身，对着观众席轻轻说了一句：It was a wonderful night, wasn't it?——这不是真的在提问，是演出结束时求一声共鸣：「今晚很棒，对吧？」全场齐声喊：Yes! 后台，小凡问老师这条「对吧」尾巴怎么造。老师说：「三条规矩。第一，尾巴跟主句用同一位助手：主句是 was，尾巴就是 wasn't；主句 She likes，实义动词自己不能上尾巴，请它的老搭档 does；主句 He can，尾巴就是 can't——助手不能换人。第二，方向相反：前面是肯定，尾巴就否定；前面已经否定，尾巴反而用肯定——It isn't cold, is it? 第三，主语缩成代词：Tom is late, isn't he?——尾巴里不再喊全名。」他顿了顿，又说：「最要紧的是怎么回答。观众喊 Yes，是因为今晚确实好，不是因为『指挥说得对』。英语的 Yes 和 No 永远跟着事实：You didn't practise, did you?——练了就是 Yes, I did，没练就是 No, I didn't。别把中文的『是啊，没练』翻成 Yes。」

cards.rule: 规矩一：尾巴用同一位助手
cards.detail: 主句是 be → 尾巴用 be；实义动词 → 尾巴请 do/does/did；情态词 → 尾巴用同一个情态词。时态人称全对齐。
cards.example: It is..., isn't it? / She likes..., doesn't she? / He can..., can't he?

cards.detail: 前肯后否，前否后肯——never/no/nothing 也算否定，尾巴要用肯定。
cards.example: You aren't cold, are you? / He never lies, does he?

cards.detail: 尾巴里的主语一律换成代词——Tom → he，the girls → they，there be 的尾巴还是 there。
cards.example: Tom is late, isn't he? / There is a park nearby, isn't there?

cards.detail: I am... 的尾巴是 aren't I（没有 amn't）；Let's... 的尾巴是 shall we。
cards.example: I am next, aren't I? / Let's have a break, shall we?

cards.detail: Yes/No 只看事实，不看对方说得对不对——事实是肯定就 Yes，事实是否定就 No，后半句跟着配套。
cards.example: — You didn't go, did you? — No, I didn't.（对，我没去）/ Yes, I did.（不，我去了）

cards.detail: 语调降下来是求确认（对吧？），语调挑上去才是真的没把握——同一条尾巴，两种唱法。
cards.example: It's your first time, isn't it?（↘确认 / ↗询问）

basic.en: It's a lovely day, isn't it?
basic.cn: 天气真好，对吧？（be 配 be，前肯后否）

basic.en: You are in Class Three, aren't you?
She plays the violin, doesn't she?
basic.cn: 她拉小提琴，对吧？（实义动词请 does）

basic.en: He can ride a bike, can't he?
basic.cn: 他会骑车，对吧？（情态词原样上尾巴）

basic.en: They went home early, didn't they?
basic.cn: 他们回去得早，对吧？（过去时请 did）

mid.en: You aren't afraid of the dark, are you?
mid.cn: 你不怕黑，对吧？（前否后肯）

mid.en: Tom didn't come to the rehearsal, did he?
mid.cn: 汤姆没来排练，对吧？（主语缩成 he）

mid.en: There is a music room upstairs, isn't there?
mid.cn: 楼上有间音乐教室，对吧？（there 留在尾巴）

mid.en: I am on the list, aren't I?
mid.cn: 名单上有我，对吧？（I am 的特殊尾巴）

mid.en: Let's start from the chorus, shall we?
mid.cn: 咱们从副歌开始，好吗？（Let's 配 shall we）

trap.en: He never forgets his lines, does he?
trap.note: never 已是否定——尾巴反着用肯定 does he。

trap.en: — You didn't lose the ticket, did you? — No, I didn't.
trap.note: 中文答「对」，英语答 No——Yes/No 跟事实走，不跟「你说得对」走。

trap.en: — She likes spicy food, doesn't she? — Yes, she does.
trap.note: 事实是肯定就 Yes——前后半句必须配套，别说 Yes, she doesn't。

trap.en: Your parents work in a hospital, don't they?
trap.cn: 你父母在医院工作，对吧？
trap.note: parents 复数缩成 they，助手是 don't。

trap.en: The little cat is hungry, isn't it?
trap.note: isn't it 只配 be 动词的 it 主语——它不是万能「对吧」。

trap.en: We had a great time, didn't we?
trap.note: had 是实义动词「度过」——尾巴请 did，不是 hadn't we。

redBlack.bad: — You didn't finish the homework, did you? — Yes.（想说：对，没写完）
redBlack.why: 英语 Yes＝写完了——把中文的「是啊」翻成 Yes，事实整个说反。

redBlack.bad: You like this song, do you?（想求一句「对吧」）
redBlack.good: You like this song, don't you?
redBlack.why: 同向尾巴在英语里是「哦？是吗」的质疑腔——求共鸣变成了挑眉毛，语气全拧。

redBlack.bad: She dances very well, isn't it?
redBlack.good: She dances very well, doesn't she?
redBlack.why: isn't it 不是万能「对吧」——实义动词的尾巴请 does，主语跟 she。

redBlack.bad: You can ride a horse, don't you?
redBlack.good: You can ride a horse, can't you?
redBlack.why: 主句有情态词 can——尾巴用同一位助手 can't。

redBlack.bad: Tom is good at maths, isn't Tom?
redBlack.good: Tom is good at maths, isn't he?
redBlack.why: 尾巴里主语缩成代词——isn't he。

redBlack.bad: They visited the museum, don't they?
redBlack.good: They visited the museum, didn't they?
redBlack.why: 主句是过去时——尾巴的助手也要盖过去戳：didn't。

redBlack.bad: He never eats sweets, doesn't he?
redBlack.good: He never eats sweets, does he?
redBlack.why: never 已算否定——尾巴反向用肯定 does he。

redBlack.bad: I am the tallest here, amn't I?
redBlack.good: I am the tallest here, aren't I?
redBlack.why: 英语没有 amn't——I am 的尾巴借用 aren't I。

redBlack.bad: Let's sing it again, will we?
redBlack.good: Let's sing it again, shall we?
redBlack.why: Let's 的固定尾巴是 shall we——邀请大家一起。

redBlack.bad: There are two pianos here, aren't they?
redBlack.good: There are two pianos here, aren't there?
redBlack.why: there be 句的尾巴主语还是 there——不换成 they。

redBlack.bad: Come earlier tomorrow, will you? 还是 won't you？
redBlack.why: 祈使句尾巴 will you / won't you 都通用——won't you 更客气些，KET 不设坑。

redBlack.good: 聊天里有人这么说；作文写 isn't it。
redBlack.why: innit 是伦敦口语把 isn't it 磨短的产物——听得懂即可，考试别用。

contrast.cn: 他会游泳，对吧？（万能「对吧」）
contrast.en: He can swim, can't he?（尾巴现做）
contrast.diff: 中文一个「对吧」走天下；英语的尾巴要跟主句对齐助手、人称、时态，还得反个方向。

contrast.en: — You didn't go, did you? — No, I didn't.
contrast.diff: 中文的「是啊」附和对方；英语的 Yes/No 只跟事实走——没去就是 No，这是最大的一个反差。

contrast.cn: 汤姆迟到了，对吧？（名字照说）
contrast.en: Tom is late, isn't he?（缩成 he）
contrast.diff: 英语尾巴里不再喊全名——主语一律缩成代词。
中文「好吗」；英语 Let's 有专属尾巴 shall we。

contrast.en: 尾巴降调是确认，升调是真问。
contrast.diff: 英语同一条尾巴两种唱法——降调求共鸣，升调表示真没把握。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 找助手、反方向、缩代词；答题时闭眼问事实——是就 Yes，不是就 No。
steps: 看主句的动词：be → 尾巴用 be；情态词 → 原样搬；实义动词 → 请 do/does/did（时态对齐）。
看方向：主句肯定 → 尾巴否定；主句有 not/never/no → 尾巴肯定。
主语缩成代词：Tom→he，the girls→they，there be→there；I am 的尾巴是 aren't I。
特殊搭配过一遍：Let's → shall we；祈使句 → will you。
回答反义疑问句：别看对方怎么问，闭眼问自己事实——事实肯定答 Yes + 肯定，事实否定答 No + 否定。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语里的『对吧』是一条会变形的小尾巴：He can swim, can't he? 她喜欢音乐是 She likes music, doesn't she? 尾巴要跟前半句配套，还要反个方向——前面肯定，尾巴就否定。咱们玩『甩尾巴』：你说一句英语，我用中文喊『对吧！』，你就把尾巴接上去。接完咱们再玩『答对吧』——这个最容易错：我用英语问你 You didn't eat my chocolate, did you? 你要是真没吃，中文说『是啊没吃』，英语却要答 No, I didn't——英语的 Yes 和 No 只认事实，不认『你说得对』。我拿几件家里的事考你，看你能不能次次都跟着事实答。」孩子答混了别批评，把「事实是什么」再问一遍就好。
questions: 尾巴的三条规矩是什么？（同一位助手、反方向、缩代词）
She sings well 的「对吧」尾巴是 isn't it 吗？该是什么？
You didn't go, did you? 如果你真没去，该答 Yes 还是 No？

sections.echo: 求一声「对吧」是全人类的通病：中文说「对吧／是吧」，法语说 n'est-ce pas，西班牙语说 ¿verdad?，德语说 oder?——都是一个固定的小词，贴在哪句后面都行。唯独英语较真：尾巴要跟主句对齐助动词、人称、时态，还得反个方向——这是它给助动词系统付出的代价。有意思的是，伦敦街头的口语已经开始「偷懒」：isn't it 被磨成了 innit，而且越来越多人拿它当万能尾巴，贴在任何句子后面——你发现了吗？英语兜了一大圈，正在往「固定小词」的方向懒回去。越常用的东西，越被磨短磨平——那条暗线，又在你眼前发生了一次。

stages.name: 认一认 · 尾巴三规矩

questions.q: 反义疑问句的尾巴和主句方向？
questions.explain: 所以才叫「反义」——前肯后否，前否后肯。

questions.q: 主句用 be 动词，尾巴用什么？
questions.explain: It is..., isn't it?——助手不换人。

questions.q: 主句是实义动词（likes），尾巴请谁？
questions.explain: 实义动词不上尾巴——请老搭档 do/does/did。

questions.q: 主句有 can，尾巴用？
questions.explain: 情态词原样搬上尾巴——can't he?

questions.q: 尾巴里的主语要变成？
questions.explain: Tom → he，the girls → they。

questions.q: I am late, ___? 的尾巴是？
questions.explain: 英语没有 amn't——借用 aren't I。

questions.q: Let's dance, ___? 的尾巴是？
questions.explain: Let's 的专属尾巴——shall we。

questions.q: never 在主句里出现，尾巴用？
questions.explain: never 已算否定——尾巴反向用肯定。

questions.q: There is a shop here, ___? 尾巴主语是？
questions.explain: there be 的尾巴还是 there。

questions.q: 回答反义疑问句，Yes/No 跟着什么走？
questions.explain: 事实肯定 Yes，事实否定 No——不看问法。

questions.q: It's hot today, ___?
questions.explain: be 配 be，前肯后否——isn't it。

questions.q: You aren't tired, ___?
questions.explain: 前否后肯——are you。

questions.q: 尾巴降调说出来，表示什么？
questions.explain: 降调是求共鸣；升调才是真没把握。

questions.q: She swims fast, ___?
questions.explain: swims 是实义动词——请 does。

questions.q: isn't it 能当万能「对吧」到处贴吗？
options: 不能——尾巴要跟主句配套
questions.explain: 中式万能尾巴是大坑——每条尾巴现做。

questions.q: Yes 后面接的半句必须是？
questions.explain: Yes+肯定、No+否定——不许混搭。

questions.q: Your sister plays the guitar, ___?
questions.explain: 实义动词 plays → doesn't；sister → she。

questions.q: The twins are in the choir, ___?
questions.explain: are → aren't；twins → they。

questions.q: Ben can't skate, ___?
questions.explain: 前否后肯——can he。

questions.q: We watched this film last month, ___?
questions.explain: 过去时实义动词——didn't we。

questions.q: Grandpa never drinks coffee, ___?
questions.explain: never 算否定——尾巴用肯定 does he。

questions.q: I am in the first group, ___?
questions.explain: I am 的特殊尾巴——aren't I。

questions.q: Let's meet at the gate, ___?
questions.explain: Let's → shall we。

questions.q: There isn't any juice left, ___?
questions.explain: 前否后肯，主语还是 there——is there。

questions.q: Miss Wang teaches us music, ___?
questions.explain: teaches → doesn't；Miss Wang → she。

questions.q: You won't be late again, ___?
questions.explain: won't 是否定——尾巴用肯定 will you。

questions.q: Your parents like travelling, ___?
questions.explain: parents 复数 → don't they。

questions.q: The concert was wonderful, ___?
questions.explain: was → wasn't it——时态对齐。

questions.q: Lily has a little brother, ___?（has＝拥有，按实义动词）
questions.explain: has 当「拥有」是实义动词——请 does。

questions.q: It didn't snow last night, ___?
questions.explain: 前否后肯——did it。

questions.q: Close the window, ___?
questions.explain: 祈使句尾巴——will you（won't you 也可）。

questions.q: Dolphins are very clever, ___?
questions.explain: are → aren't；dolphins → they。

questions.q: 哪句的尾巴接对了？（她歌唱得好）
questions.explain: 实义动词请 does——isn't it 是中式万能尾巴。

questions.q: 哪句的尾巴接对了？（他会弹钢琴）
options: He can play the piano, can't he?
He can play the piano, doesn't he?
He can play the piano, isn't he?
questions.explain: 主句的助手是 can——尾巴 can't。

questions.q: 哪句的主语缩对了？
options: Uncle Li grows vegetables, doesn't he?
Uncle Li grows vegetables, doesn't Uncle Li?
Uncle Li grows vegetables, doesn't it?
questions.explain: Uncle Li → he。

questions.q: 哪句的时态对齐了？
options: You bought a new kite, didn't you?
You bought a new kite, don't you?
You bought a new kite, aren't you?
questions.explain: bought 是过去——didn't you。

questions.q: 哪句的方向对了？（他从不迟到）
options: He is never late, is he?
He is never late, isn't he?
He is never late, does he?
questions.explain: never 算否定 → 尾巴肯定；主句是 be → is he。

questions.q: 哪句的特殊尾巴对了？
options: I am your partner, aren't I?
I am your partner, amn't I?
I am your partner, am not I?
questions.explain: aren't I——独一份的借用。

questions.q: 哪句的 Let's 尾巴对了？
options: Let's practise the duet, shall we?
Let's practise the duet, will we?
Let's practise the duet, do we?
questions.explain: shall we。

questions.q: 哪句的 there be 尾巴对了？
options: There are many stars tonight, aren't there?
There are many stars tonight, aren't they?
There are many stars tonight, isn't it?
questions.explain: 尾巴主语还是 there。

questions.q: 哪组问答配套没错？（事实：她确实在学画画）
options: — She is learning to draw, isn't she? — Yes, she is.
— She is learning to draw, isn't she? — Yes, she isn't.
— She is learning to draw, isn't she? — No, she is.
questions.explain: Yes+肯定配套——Yes, she is。

questions.q: 哪组问答对了？（事实：我没带伞）
options: — You didn't bring an umbrella, did you? — No, I didn't.
— You didn't bring an umbrella, did you? — Yes, I didn't.
— You didn't bring an umbrella, did you? — Yes.（想说对，没带）
questions.explain: 没带就是 No, I didn't——中文「是啊」别翻成 Yes。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（你哥哥不吃香菜）
options: Your brother doesn't eat coriander, does he?
Your brother doesn't eat coriander, doesn't he?
Your brother doesn't eat coriander, is he?
questions.explain: 前否后肯——does he。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（今晚月亮真亮）
options: The moon is really bright tonight, isn't it?
The moon is really bright tonight, doesn't it?
The moon is really bright tonight, isn't there?
questions.explain: be 配 be，moon → it。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（他们上周赢了比赛）
options: They won the match last week, didn't they?
They won the match last week, don't they?
They won the match last week, weren't they?
questions.explain: won 过去时——didn't they。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（外面没什么声音）
options: There is nothing outside, is there?
There is nothing outside, isn't there?
There is nothing outside, is it?
questions.explain: nothing 算否定 → 尾巴肯定 is there。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（把门关上吧——祈使）
options: Shut the door gently, will you?
Shut the door gently, shall we?
Shut the door gently, don't you?
questions.explain: 祈使句 → will you。

questions.q: 哪句尾巴全对？（我们该出发了——Let's）
options: Let's set off now, shall we?
Let's set off now, will you?
Let's set off now, do we?
questions.explain: Let's → shall we。

questions.q: 演出结束想求共鸣「今晚真棒，对吧」：
options: It was a great night, wasn't it?
It was a great night, isn't it?
It was a great night, was it?
questions.explain: was → wasn't——时态对齐，前肯后否。

questions.q: 确认朋友会来：「你明天会来的，对吧？」
options: You will come tomorrow, won't you?
You will come tomorrow, will you?
You will come tomorrow, don't you?
questions.explain: will → won't you。

questions.q: — The show starts at seven, doesn't it? — ___（事实：确实七点开始）
questions.explain: 事实肯定 → Yes + 肯定配套。

questions.q: — You haven't seen my glasses, have you? — ___（事实：真没见过）
questions.explain: 没见过＝事实否定 → No, I haven't。

questions.q: — Tom didn't break the string, did he? — ___（事实：还真是他弄断的）
options: No, he didn't.（想说是他弄的）
questions.explain: 事实肯定 → Yes, he did——「不，是他弄的」英语说 Yes。

questions.q: 和同学商量：「咱们课后加练一次，好吗？」
options: Let's have one more practice after class, shall we?
Let's have one more practice after class, will you?
Let's have one more practice after class, do we?
questions.explain: Let's → shall we。

questions.q: 跟新同学套近乎：「你也是三年级的，对吧？」
options: You are in Grade Three too, aren't you?
You are in Grade Three too, are you?
You are in Grade Three too, don't you?
questions.explain: are → aren't you——求共鸣用反向尾巴。

questions.q: 妈妈叮嘱出门的你：「别忘带钥匙，好吗？」（祈使）
options: Don't forget your keys, will you?
Don't forget your keys, shall we?
Don't forget your keys, won't they?
questions.explain: 否定祈使句尾巴用 will you。

questions.q: 确认排练厅还空着：「楼上没人在用琴房，对吧？」
options: Nobody is using the piano room, are they?
Nobody is using the piano room, is he?
Nobody is using the piano room, isn't it?
questions.explain: nobody 算否定 → 尾巴肯定；nobody 的尾巴代词习惯用 they。

questions.q: — I am the last one to perform, aren't I? — ___（事实：确实是）
questions.explain: Yes + 肯定——Yes, you are。

questions.q: 确认天气：「昨晚没下雨，对吧？」
options: It didn't rain last night, did it?
It didn't rain last night, didn't it?
It didn't rain last night, does it?
questions.explain: 前否后肯 + 过去时——did it。

questions.q: 夸完再确认：「你妹妹五岁就会拉琴了，对吧？」
options: Your sister could play the violin at five, couldn't she?
Your sister could play the violin at five, can't she?
Your sister could play the violin at five, didn't she?
questions.explain: could → couldn't she——情态词的过去形也原样搬。

questions.q: — There was a rainbow this morning, wasn't there? — ___（事实：有）
questions.explain: there be 的回答也带 there——Yes, there was。

questions.q: 哪句「同向尾巴」的理解是对的？——You like it, do you?
options: 带着「哦？是吗」的惊讶质疑腔
和 don't you 完全一样
是语法错误，任何时候都不能说
questions.explain: 同向尾巴合法但变了味——求共鸣要用反向。

questions.q: 翻译陷阱：「——你没吃早饭吧？——是啊。」英语版是：
options: — You didn't have breakfast, did you? — No, I didn't.
— You didn't have breakfast, did you? — Yes, I didn't.
— You didn't have breakfast, did you? — Yes.（附和对方）
questions.explain: 「是啊（没吃）」＝事实否定＝No, I didn't。

questions.q: 大考：接尾巴三连——I am next, ___? / Let's warm up, ___? / You never get nervous, ___?
options: aren't I / shall we / do you
amn't I / will we / don't you
aren't I / will you / doesn't you
questions.explain: 三个特殊点一次考齐：aren't I、shall we、never→肯定尾巴 do you。

detective.sentence: Your cousin swims very fast, isn't it?
detective.fixed: Your cousin swims very fast, doesn't he? / doesn't she?
detective.clue: isn't it 不是万能「对吧」——实义动词请 does，主语缩成 he/she。

detective.sentence: You can join us this Sunday, don't you?
detective.fixed: You can join us this Sunday, can't you?
detective.clue: 主句的助手是 can——尾巴用同一位：can't you。

detective.sentence: Anna is in the art club, isn't Anna?
detective.fixed: Anna is in the art club, isn't she?
detective.clue: 尾巴里的主语要缩成代词——isn't she。

detective.sentence: They planted the trees in spring, don't they?
detective.fixed: They planted the trees in spring, didn't they?
detective.clue: planted 是过去时——尾巴的助手也要盖过去戳。

detective.sentence: He never misses the morning practice, doesn't he?
detective.fixed: He never misses the morning practice, does he?
detective.clue: never 已算否定——尾巴反向用肯定 does he。

detective.sentence: Let's listen to it one more time, will we?
detective.fixed: Let's listen to it one more time, shall we?
detective.clue: Let's 的专属尾巴是 shall we。

detective.sentence: — You didn't see my cat, did you? — Yes, I didn't.
detective.fixed: — You didn't see my cat, did you? — No, I didn't.
detective.clue: Yes 后面只能接肯定——「对，没看见」是 No, I didn't，Yes/No 跟事实走。
